method: Opening-frame RGB area resampling to 96x54 and mean per-channel local SSIM (Gaussian 7x7, sigma 1.5, range 255) against the 12 distinct starts. runnerUpSsim is the next distinct plant. nextTakeSsim is the best other take for the same start. Each pair shares its start. The element suffix identifies the chosen runtime mask or a trial folder for a static row. Prompt provenance is unknown for all takes.

elements.finding: A small sway runs through the hanging clusters of both willows. The wider mask follows the yellow-green tips through the turn at 2 s. The trunks, shadows and grass between the trees hold.
At 2 s the right tassels lift away from their painted dark contours on both crowns.
Near 3 s the lowest left leaves smear into the grass while thin, empty contours remain under the right tassel.
The right tassel lifts near 3 s and leaves its lower outline hanging below the moving leaves.
At 2 s a second outline follows the outside of the left crown, with hollow tips under the right crown.
At 2.17 s the leaves have moved up, exposing scalloped rest-pose outlines below both boughs.
At 3 s the fern next to the terrace recedes inside its painted outline. An empty hook remains where its rightmost leaflet was.
At 1.42 s the rightmost yellow leaflet loses its fill and leaves a dark arc. This also appears in the narrower mask.
Detached pale leaves appear in front of the west scrub from 2 to 3 s and survive both masks.
The soft brown shrubs resolve into sharp, pale-tipped leaves near 1.8 s. The blue agave also retains outlines above its moving tips.
At 1.83 s red sand shows through the upper agave tips inside their original triangular outlines.
The yellow flower heads acquire dark doubled petal edges near 6 s, and outlines persist beside the agave tips.
The tan grass bends slightly and the yellow sprigs stir on their stems. The tighter mask keeps the rock ledge and the red sand quiet through the return.
At 1.92 s the yellow foliage moves across the red ground and leaves a second set of petal outlines beside its stems.
At 1.79 s the agave blades pull inwards and their pointed contours remain visible against the sand.
At 1.25 s the fan contracts and exposes several hollow triangular tips around its centre.
The tallest blue-green blades flex slightly near 1.7 s. The wider mask follows their pale tips, with the mushrooms, pebbles and moonlight steady.
Near 2.1 s the upper half of the reed fan loses its pale paint and collapses into thin outlines.
Near 3 s the back blades of the lower reeds fade into the ground, leaving faint strokes above the fans.
Near 1.67 s several blades split into a moving blue streak and a stationary pale tip.
New silver leaf shapes flash across the dark foreground below the pools, especially near 3.1 s.
Two pale seed-head shapes sweep across the open blue foliage between the pools from 2 to 4 s.
A dark fern appears on the empty ground to the right of the upper pool near 2 s.
Large silver fern fronds spread across the dark foreground below the lamp and beside the stump.

registrationMethod: Both masks tested over all 192 frames at scale 2 with an inward feather of two layout pixels. The raw wrap and adjacent-step measurements precede the optional packer end blend. Peak and step indices are zero-based at 24 fps.
